scope: Synthetic WebAudio speech and mocked client results using the Android startup prompt; muted local output; no physical phone or real Pi tasks.

cases.case: Spoken interruption while assistant turn was active

conclusion: The native subscription session accepted input during a reply and after a reply, producing three client delegations without client-side interruption controls. The Android coordinator must not block result delivery on JSON audio-delta/playback events.
limits: One earlier setup attempt did not connect; the successful synthetic run does not establish general connection reliability.
Muted local output and RTP counts do not prove audible speech or its exact stop time.
The test does not reproduce native Android capture, echo cancellation, headset hotplug, or real Pi task execution.
Android compilation, lifecycle regressions, and routing instrumentation run separately in GitHub Actions; physical-phone acceptance is still required.
